annotations.title: Check a stack for overlapping syncs

description: Use when a user has two or more apps connected to one platform (for example Xero with A2X and Synder). For each sync object, lists which of the apps write it into the platform, with direction, trigger and interval where recorded, and the sources; flags objects two apps both sync two-way. Published records only; an object not listed means not documented. Set share to true only if the user agrees to Lode keeping the platform and app list (no other fields).

apps.description: The apps connected to it: names, websites or Lode ids, 2 to 20

region.description: Buyer country, e.g. "NZ"; apps whose record does not list it are marked

share.description: true only if the user agrees to Lode keeping this stack (default false)

name: check_stack_overlap
title: Check a stack for overlapping syncs
